title: Zun`Muram Yihst Vor
summary: Yihst Vor escalates his melee pressure and finishes with area rampage.
overview: Yihst Vor escalates his melee pressure and finishes with area rampage.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Maintain charm recovery and keep the raid healed before the final area-rampage phase.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: His melee tuning changes at 90%, 75% and 50% health.
Allure runs on a 90-second combat timer and activates charm helpers.
At 20%, single-target rampage and flurry are replaced by area rampage.
The room seals at the initial health threshold and pulls escaping hate-list players back.

notes: Approval E337. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
